root: ^A noblewoman beckons you over with a flick of her fan, leaning in close.

g-0: ^"Ssh! Come here, dear. I have the most delicious rumor."

s: ^"What do you think of the ball?"

rumor_talk: ^"My maid's cousin works in the kitchens, and she swears she overheard someone say Estelle had an important errand in the Princess Brooklyn's chambers."

g-0: ^"Something regarding a letter. Unusual, since she's normally Alistair's attendant, not Brooklyn's! Can you imagine?"
g-1: ^"That poor child is mixed up in something dangerous. Though you know how servants gossip—who knows if it's even true!"
g-2: ^"But that poor child does look terrified."

nobles_talk: ^"Oh, where do I start? Cornellius has been Alistair's shadow for years, but lately... I've noticed him watching his 'mentor' carefully."

g-0: ^"Though I must say, tonight he's been remarkably... visible. Almost making sure people see him in the ballroom."
g-1: ^"Establishing presence, if you know what I mean."

ball_talk: ^"Brooklyn certainly knows how to throw an event, though one wonders at the timing."

g-0: ^"Hosting a grand masquerade right when she’s about to be shipped off to this far away country?"
g-1: ^She raises an eyebrow suggestively. "Either she's brilliantly bold or dangerously stupid. My money's on the former."
g-2: ^"That girl's got more spine than her brother has in his whole body."

ending: ^She taps her chin with her fan, her eyes scanning for a new target.

g-0: ^"But look at me, talking your ear off. Go on, dear. Go see the drama for yourself."
